# Remote content-tab icon handling leaves an explicit nonremote DOM-link path

The change removes remote browsers from the legacy DOM-link listener path and removes specialTabs default-favicon guessing. Nonremote browsers still register those listeners, with a comment explaining chrome documents, and the legacy setter remains. LinkHandlerParent also limits itself to a content tab and rechecks browser membership after asynchronous conversion. Preserve those boundaries instead of treating the title as universal single-setter ownership.

Scope: content-tab-icon-owner-scope.
